fullPassage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customer-centered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or increasing its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘give away the house’.

❌ ③ raising: 가격을 '올리면' 만족이 떨어지므로, 만족을 높이는 방법은 가격을 '낮추는' 것

det.tip: exceptional(탁월한) ↔ ordinary(평범한), lowering(낮추기) ↔ raising(올리기), profitably(수익성 있게) ↔ wastefully(낭비하며)

det.tip: high(높은) ↔ low(낮은). broad·distant·strong은 의미축이 다른 함정

questions.passage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customer-centered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or <u>increasing</u> its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘give away the house’.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>increasing</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: increasing=늘리는 / gathering=모으는 / reducing=줄이는 / measuring=측정하는 / repeating=반복하는
det.analysis:
✅ ② reducing: '줄이는'이라는 뜻으로 increasing(늘리는)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ① gathering: '모으는' — 수집의 개념이라 의미축이 다름
❌ ③ measuring: '측정하는' — 재는 행위라 무관
❌ ④ repeating: '반복하는' — 되풀이의 개념이라 반의어가 아님
det.tip: increasing(늘리는) ↔ reducing(줄이는). gathering·measuring·repeating은 의미축이 다른 함정

questions.passage:
(A) The company promises to <u>deliver</u> a truly memorable experience to every guest.

(B) The courier service will <u>deliver</u> the package to your door by noon.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 deliver의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: deliver: (A) (경험·서비스를) 제공하다, 주다 (B) (물건을) 배달하다
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 호텔이 기억할 만한 경험을 '제공한다(준다)', (B) 택배 서비스가 소포를 문 앞까지 '배달한다' ←정답
❌ ① (A)와 (B)의 뜻이 서로 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) '연설하다'는 여기서 deliver의 뜻이 아님 (deliver a speech일 때만)
❌ ④ (B) 소포를 '출산한다'는 어색하고 '배달한다'가 맞음
det.tip: deliver 다의어: ① (서비스·경험을) 제공하다 ② (물건을) 배달하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "other companies that try to sell similar products or services to the same customers"

det.korean: customers=고객 / marketers=마케팅 담당자 / competitors=경쟁사 / guests=손님
det.analysis:
✅ ③ competitors: 같은 고객에게 비슷한 상품·서비스를 팔려는 '다른 회사들' → '경쟁사(competitors)' ←정답. 본문 relative to competitors(경쟁사 대비) 참고
❌ ① customers: '고객' — 물건을 사는 쪽이라 정의와 다름
❌ ② marketers: '마케팅 담당자' — 파는 사람이지 경쟁 회사가 아님
❌ ④ guests: '손님' — 정의와 무관
det.tip: sell similar products to the same customers(같은 고객에게 비슷한 상품을 파는) = competitors(경쟁사)

questions.passage: For companies __________ (interest) in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: interest(관심을 갖게 하다) → interested(과거분사). 명사 companies를 뒤에서 꾸미며 '~에 관심 있는'이라는 뜻을 나타낸다.
det.analysis: interest를 과거분사 interested로 바꿉니다. 'companies ___ in delighting customers'에서 빈칸은 앞의 명사 companies(회사들)를 꾸며 '고객을 기쁘게 하는 데 관심 있는 회사들'이라는 뜻을 만드는 자리예요. 사람·주체가 무언가에 '관심을 느끼는' 것이므로 과거분사 interested가 맞습니다. (companies which are interested에서 which are가 생략된 형태)
det.tip: 감정을 '느끼는' 주체를 꾸밀 때는 과거분사(-ed). interest → interested

questions.passage: Although a customer-centered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by __________ (lower) its price or increasing its services.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: lower(낮추다) → lowering(동명사). 전치사 by 뒤에서 '~함으로써'라는 방법을 나타내고, 뒤의 increasing과 병렬을 이룬다.
det.analysis: lower를 동명사 lowering으로 바꿉니다. 'by ___ its price or increasing its services'에서 전치사 by 뒤에는 동사가 -ing(동명사) 형태로 와야 해요. 또 뒤에 나오는 increasing(늘리기)과 나란히 이어지는 병렬 구조라서 같은 형태인 lowering이 맞습니다. '가격을 낮추거나 서비스를 늘려서'라는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: 전치사 by 뒤 + 뒤의 increasing과 병렬 = 동명사(-ing). lower → lowering

questions.passage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall __________. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customer-centered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or increasing its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘give away the house’.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: company culture=기업문화 / price list=가격표 / sales report=판매 보고서 / hotel lobby=호텔 로비
det.analysis:
✅ ① company culture: 고객을 감동시키려는 기업에서는 탁월한 가치와 서비스가 전체 '기업문화'의 일부가 된다 ←정답
❌ ② price list: '가격표'는 가치·서비스가 문화가 된다는 흐름과 무관
❌ ③ sales report: '판매 보고서'는 문맥에 근거 없음
❌ ④ hotel lobby: '호텔 로비'는 구체적 장소라 문맥과 안 맞음
det.tip: exceptional value and service become part of the overall ___ → company culture(기업문화)

questions.passage: For companies interested in delighting customers, exceptional value and service become part of the overall company culture. For example, year after year, Pazano ranks at or near the top of the hospitality industry in terms of customer satisfaction. The company’s passion for satisfying customers is summed up in its credo, which promises that its luxury hotels will deliver a truly memorable experience. Although a customer-centered firm seeks to deliver high customer satisfaction relative to competitors, it does not attempt to maximize customer satisfaction. A company can always increase customer satisfaction by lowering its price or increasing its services. But this may result in lower profits. Thus, the purpose of marketing is to generate customer value profitably. This requires a very delicate balance: the marketer must continue to generate more customer value and satisfaction but not ‘__________’.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: lower the price=가격을 낮추다 / close the store=가게를 닫다 / ignore the guests=손님을 무시하다 / give away the house=집을 다 내주다(가진 것을 다 내주다)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ give away the house: 마케터는 더 많은 고객 가치와 만족을 계속 만들되, 이익을 다 잃을 만큼 '가진 것을 다 내주지'는 말아야 한다 ←정답
❌ ① lower the price: 가격 낮추기는 만족을 높이는 '방법'으로 앞에 나왔을 뿐, 여기서 '하지 말아야 할 것'으로는 맞지 않음
❌ ② close the store: '가게를 닫다'는 본문에 근거 없음
❌ ③ ignore the guests: '손님을 무시하다'는 고객 만족을 높이려는 글의 취지와 무관
det.tip: generate more value but not ___ → 이익을 다 잃지 말라는 뜻의 관용구 give away the house(다 내주다)
